measuredSpectrum.source: Burnashev (1985), Abastumani Astrophys. Obs. Bull. 59, 83; VizieR III/126, part2 record 45 (BS 1464)

gaps.reason: the spectrum ends at 755 nm; the last value is held to 780 nm, where the observer adds little

measuredSpectrum.note: Ground-based scans of the Chilean catalogue in Burnashev's compilation, as log10 flux.

crossCheck.disagreement: The Gaia DR3 XP color differs from the Burnashev color by 24 levels. The star is G 3.57, brighter than the G 4 under which Gaia's spectra can be saturated (De Angeli et al. 2023, A&A 674, A2; color.mts XP_SATURATION_G), so the Burnashev color is used.
